Question 6
?

At each point P on a particular curve, the derivative y′(x) is proportional to the slope of the line through P and the origin. The derivative at the point (2,−4) equals −8. What differential equation describes this curve?

a
 y′(x)=4xy
b
 y′(x)=16xy
c
 y′(x)=yx
d
 y′(x)=4xy
e
y′(x)=4yx
